title: UN ruling disputes Israeli allegations used to dismiss UNRWA Gaza staff
detail: Al Jazeera reports on Nov 26 that a UN ruling disputes the Israeli allegations that were used to dismiss UNRWA staff in Gaza. Only the headline was available at the time of writing; the ruling body, number of staff affected and any Israeli response remain unconfirmed.
